summary: Well-structured TDD-driven test suite with good coverage of core parsing, license resolution, and compliance reporting logic. Uses Pester appropriately with sound mocking practices and fixture cleanup. Workflow structure validation is thorough. Main gaps: (1) CLI entry point unit tests only exercise one fixture (package-denied.json) of three scenarios defined in acceptance tests—should test all-approved and all-unknown cases via Pester; (2) acceptance test harness (run-act-tests.ps1) is not a Pester test, requiring separate invocation; (3) some config error scenarios untested (malformed policy/license-database JSON, empty manifests); (4) report output table format not directly asserted. Would catch most regressions in core logic and workflow structure, but incomplete CLI fixture coverage creates risk of missed output-format changes.
